description: Queue a large HTML or Markdown document (up to 100 pages) for asynchronous rendering. Returns a job_id; set wait to true to poll until it finishes and return the download link. Docs: https://apidocs.podpdf.com/api-reference/longjob

content.description: The HTML or Markdown to render

margin.description: Margin for all four sides, e.g. "20mm" or "0.5in"

printBackground.description: Print background colours and images (default true)

wait.description: Wait up to 3 minutes for the job to finish (default false)

name: start_long_job
title: Start Long Job
